name: Contract Obligation & Renewal Tracker – LlamaParse + AI + Slack Approvals

parameters.content:
## 📑 Contract Obligation & Renewal Tracker

For small legal, finance and ops teams who keep contracts in Drive and only notice an auto-renewal after the notice window has closed. A missed notice can lock you into another year of a vendor you meant to drop.

### How it works
Drop a contract PDF into a Drive folder. LlamaParse converts it to markdown and GPT-4o-mini extracts the parties, dates, auto-renewal terms, notice period and obligations. Everything lands in a Google Sheets register, and the team gets a Slack summary.

Every morning the register is checked. At 90, 60 and 30 days before the notice deadline, Slack gets a message with one-click Renew and Terminate links. Renewals are confirmed. Terminations get an AI-drafted notice saved in Gmail for review. Obligations due within a week go out in a daily digest.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with **Contracts** and **Obligations** tabs, and a Drive folder for incoming contracts.
2. Connect Google Drive, Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack and OpenAI. Add your LlamaCloud API key as Header Auth (`Authorization: Bearer …`).
3. Replace the `REPLACE_WITH_…` placeholders: folder ID, sheet ID, Slack channel ID, and your n8n base URL in **Find Due Renewal Milestones**.
4. Upload a sample contract, check the register and Slack, then activate.

## 📂 Detect & Download
Watches your contracts folder in Google Drive. Only PDFs are picked up and downloaded for parsing.

## 📄 Parse with LlamaParse
LlamaParse turns the PDF into clean markdown, so tables and clauses survive. The workflow polls every 15 seconds until the job finishes, and posts to Slack if it fails.

## 🧠 Extract & Register
GPT-4o-mini reads the contract and pulls out the counterparty, dates, auto-renewal, notice period and obligations. The notice deadline is calculated and the contract is upserted into the register.

## 📌 Notify & Save Obligations
Posts a summary of the new contract to Slack, then saves each obligation as its own row so it can be tracked to a due date.

## ⏰ Renewal Milestones
Every morning, contracts are checked against their notice deadline. At 90, 60 and 30 days, and once overdue, Slack gets a message with Renew and Terminate links. Each milestone is sent once.

## 📋 Obligations Digest
Anything due in the next seven days, or already overdue and still open, goes into one daily Slack digest.

## 🔗 Decision Link & Validation
Clicking Renew or Terminate hits this webhook. The one-time token is checked against the register, so old or forwarded links can't change a decision twice.

## ✅ Record Decision
Saves the decision, shows a confirmation page in the browser, then routes to the next step. Invalid links get a clear error page instead.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Renew or Draft Termination

parameters.content:
## ✉️ Renew or Draft Termination
A renewal is confirmed in Slack. A termination gets an AI-drafted notice saved as a Gmail draft, ready for legal to review and send before the deadline.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use OAuth2 for Google and Slack, and store the LlamaCloud and OpenAI keys as credentials. Decision links carry a one-time token, so share them only in a private channel. Contracts may hold confidential terms, so restrict access to the sheet.

nodes.name: Ask Renew or Terminate in Slack

values.content:
You are a senior contracts analyst. Extract the key commercial and renewal terms from the contract text.
Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly this shape:
{
 "contract_title": string,
 "counterparty_name": string,
 "counterparty_email": string|null,
 "effective_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null,
 "expiry_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null,
 "auto_renew": boolean,
 "auto_renew_clause": string,
 "renewal_term_months": number|null,
 "notice_period_days": number,
 "termination_clause": string,
 "contract_value": number|null,
 "currency": string|null,
 "summary": string,
 "key_risks": [string],
 "obligations": [{"obligation": string, "owner_party": "Us"|"Counterparty", "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null, "frequency": "one-time"|"monthly"|"quarterly"|"annually"|"ongoing"}]
}
Rules: If only a term is given (e.g. "12 months from the Effective Date"), compute expiry_date. Convert notice periods to days (1 month = 30). Use 0 if there is no notice period. Never invent dates. Use null when a value is unclear. Keep key_risks to at most 5 and obligations to at most 15. Keep the summary to 2 sentences.

values.content:
You draft formal contract non-renewal / termination notices for a company's legal team.
Return ONLY JSON: {"subject": string, "body": string}.
The body is plain text and formal. It references the contract title and effective date, cites the notice/termination clause provided, states the intention not to renew and to terminate at expiry (or per the clause), requests written acknowledgement, and ends with "[Authorised Signatory]". Do not invent facts or legal claims that aren't in the input.
